# RHEEMA — Premium Kitchen Storage by Ranpa Exim Pvt Ltd

RHEEMA is a kitchen-storage brand by Ranpa Exim Pvt Ltd (Madhira, Khammam,
Telangana, India). Flagship product: the RHEEMA 6 Grid Rotating Food
Dispenser, a 360° rotating dry-food storage unit with 6 separate
compartments and one-touch dispensing drawer.

## Featured product

- RHEEMA 6 Grid Rotating Food Dispenser
- Price: ₹1,499 (MRP ₹2,499, save ₹1,000, delivery included)
- Dimensions: 26 × 25.5 × 25.5 cm
- Material: food-grade, BPA-free plastic
- Features: 360° rotation, one-touch dispensing drawer, transparent storage
  window, moisture & dust protection, 6 sealed compartments
- For: rice, lentils, beans, cereals and other dry foods
- Orders: via WhatsApp +91 73829 26533, or Add to Cart on the homepage and pay with Razorpay (UPI, cards, netbanking). Bulk/wholesale welcome, MOQ 50 on IndiaMART.
- Returns: 30 days (defects and change of mind); refunds to the original payment method within 14 days; a return charge is deducted on returns after payment.
- Order updates: shared at every step after booking — confirmation, packing, shipping, delivery.
- Terms: https://www.rheema.in/terms.html
- Brand tagline: "Organized Today. Peace of Mind Everyday."
